Priya R: Attaching draft RFI answers and capability matrix for Pelotonix. Need final pricing tiers and confirmation on KMS/HSM language. Attachments: pelotonix_capability_matrix.xlsx, pelotonix_rfi_answers.pdf Link: https://drive.google.com/fake-pelotonix
Marcus G: Quick note  Pelotonix wants both 14-day and 30-day POC pricing options and an explicit note about data residency in EU.
Elena T: For data residency we can host POC in eu-west-1 region; mention that in matrix under "data locality".
Kiran S: Proposed infra: 1x A100-80GB baseline, optional burst to T4s. Latency 95th for 256 tokens on A100 ~90ms (int8 adds ~8%). I'll add exact numbers to matrix.
Priya R: Pricing draft:
- 14-day POC (1x A100): $5,500
- 30-day POC (1x A100): $9,000
- Pilot monthly (2x A100 reserved): $55,000/mo
FinanceBot: Flag: need finance approval for discounted 14-day rate. Also note taxes and region surcharges.
SecOps Bot: Scan complete: pelotonix_rfi_answers.pdf shows references to GDPR; add statement about data retention policy.
Marcus G: Can we promise encryption in transit and at rest? Also they asked about key rotation frequency for CMEK.
Kiran S: Yes, encryption in transit and at rest supported. For CMEK key rotation depends on KMS provider; recommend quarterly rotation as best practice. Add to RFI.
Elena T: Pelotonix requested an SLA of 99.95% for Pilot. Our default tier is 99.5 hosted; 99.95 requires Dedicated + SLA add-on.
Priya R: I'll update documents and get finance/legal sign-off. Target send date 2026-03-29 EOD.
Marcus G: :thumbsup:
